title: The Half-Light Inventory
author: Ulyana Dravenmoor
blurb: Ines Quintana, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
